summary: Independent source-only review of the complete unexecuted V2 E1514 proposal. Exact supplied source and recovered receipt hashes match. The hash-before-decode boundary, frozen literal 16/160 plan, raw-wire retention, common CLI/CSV records, fixed banks and UNKNOWN/no-CV scope are present in source. Amend the decoded answer/identity refusal checks and compact native-null/condition labels before later renderer engineering execution. These are static engineering counterexamples, not observations or scientific measurements of any producer result.

findings.finding: The decoded native answer validator has profile/contrast/loss branches but no edgePair value-shape check, and the resolved-identity check is skipped whenever identity is null, including attempted rows.
concrete_unexecuted_counterexamples: In an otherwise contract-bound decoded fixed160 trace, replace a COMPLETED edgePair nativeAnswer with {unit:'px',value:17}. At line93 it has string unit and own value; line94 enters but no edgePair branch exists. Line100 can retain the original correct identity. Validation therefore does not refuse. Lines116/131 then access 17.lPx etc. and emit unavailable values rather than a malformed-value refusal or native scalar17. The same hole accepts value:{} or value:false; false additionally skips line94.

In an otherwise valid COMPLETED or THREW query row, set resolvedIdentity:null. Line100 skips all identity checks. Frozen recipe source sets resolvedIdentity before incrementing attemptedPATH and before the call, so attempted-with-null is inconsistent with that producer's retained row shape but is not refused. All NOT_ATTEMPTED rows may legitimately retain null; preserve that partial case.
findings.requested_amendment: Add explicit bounded native outcome shape handling for edgePair (supported native null/condition and supported fit object with explicit retained scalar fields), reject unsupported primitives/missing fit shape instead of projecting them as unavailable, and require a valid resolvedIdentity for attempted states while allowing null for unattempted rows. Do not regenerate queries or add scientific acceptance constraints.
findings.limits: Hypothetical decoder-valid input counterexamples derived from control flow only; no fixture was authored/run and no current raw result was inspected. The externally trusted raw-acceptance gate remains important, but does not make the claimed decoded-schema refusal checks complete.

findings.finding: Compact SVG panels do not preserve the native-null/condition distinctions already present in the shared exact records; compact loss summaries omit native conditions.
concrete_unexecuted_counterexamples: A COMPLETED edgePair envelope with native value:null is explicitly admitted by lines93-99. Line114 creates native-value=null in shared CSV records, and line131 says native null in HTML. Line149 instead takes the final branch and produces native c=unavailable w=unavailable px. This is a native-null versus absent-field divergence between consumers of the same model.

A COMPLETED profile or contrast envelope with value:null yields Profile COMPLETED at line146 or Contrast COMPLETED at line148, without saying native null. A COMPLETED loss value:{condition:'NO_VISIBLE_SUPPORT'} is admitted as a condition and retained by line114, but lines150/165 display unavailable loss quantities and never the retained condition in the compact loss summary. These exact condition strings are illustrative engineering input, not claimed native observations.
findings.requested_amendment: Use a shared explicit outcome label for missing answer, native null, native condition and native value across SVG/HTML summaries, then show numeric fit/loss labels only for the corresponding value shape. Keep exact CSV tokens, raw links, all16 comparisons and all width banks unchanged.
findings.limits: Static output-string derivation only. No SVG/HTML/CSV was generated or visually inspected. Exact detailed records/raw links already retain these outcomes; the finding is compact-view inconsistency, not raw-byte loss.
